review.coverage: All 60 native frames inspected in consecutive full-frame and face-crop contact sheets; six selected face crops enlarged for detail review.
review.likenessAndDetail: Broadly recognizable against approved keyframes, with some facial texture softening/change during motion; exact likeness and unchanged fine detail cannot be certified.
review.motion: One turn toward the viewer, mostly frontal by about one second, with slight residual movement afterward. Mouth remains closed in inspected frames; no obvious speaking.
review.decision: Do not integrate. A final-frame hold cannot remove a blink during the turn; skipping or synthesizing eye frames is not an approved quality fix.

audio: Provider included an AAC audio stream despite the silent-shot prompt. Review deliverable removes audio using video stream copy; no video re-encoding.
retryPolicy: No further paid generation authorized. No automatic retry.
verificationScope: Media inspection and documentation only; no new website build or browser testing claimed.
